item.text: The text contains exactly four copies of the same word-and-punctuation multiset, but their ordering has been discarded. I’m checking whether the numbered steps still retain enough association to yield a unique result.
Cannot determine uniquely: the shuffle erased which operation belongs to steps 1–6, so multiple valid orderings produce different final labels.
